senses.zh_definition: 多诺万：源自爱尔兰的人名，可作姓氏，也可作男性名字。
senses.en_definition: An Irish-origin surname, also used as a masculine given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang berasal daripada nama keluarga Ireland dan juga digunakan sebagai nama lelaki.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas，即专有名词；不是具有独立马来语普通词义的词。仅凭输入不能确定具体人物。以下为可自由组合的姓名短语，并非有语料频次证明的固定搭配。其人名来源见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/donovan)。

etymology.historical_story: Donovan belongs to an Irish naming tradition. The surname is an English form of Ó Donndubháin, identifying descent from a person named Donndubán. It also became a masculine given name. A historical surname can therefore function as someone's first name, while remaining unchanged when mentioned in a Malay sentence. Its ancestry is separate from Malay morphology. [Sources: surname](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/donovan), [given name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/donovan).
